title: Quick Thai Cauliflower Som Tum
description: A mustardy and indulgent Thai dish featuring cauliflower, this recipe brings the flavors of Bangkok street food to your table with a Mediterranean twist, using the tandoor for a smoky flavor.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor or a grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, toss the cauliflower florets with 1 tablespoon of peanut oil and season with salt.
Grill the cauliflower in the tandoor for 5 minutes on each side, or until tender and slightly charred.
In a blender or food processor, combine the chilies, garlic, fish sauce, lime juice, and palm sugar, and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the grilled cauliflower, the chili mixture, and the chopped peanuts, and toss to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the som tum chilled or at room temperature.
Garnish with additional peanuts and chilies, if desired.
